dogecoin.text: @Spacesex0GNut @safemoon Dogecoin community was growing regardless of Elon. Yes there is a pump in the price, but Dogecoin would be a .04 coin naturally on community alone. This is a coin that I bought at .00009 years ago. Safemoon can do the same over time, emphasis on TIME.

@safemoon In order for Safemoon to succeed it needs to build a community over time. However, if people keep leaving because the price isn’t moving higher everyday, then you are the problem. I’ve been part of the Dogecoin community for years, we didn’t get to where we are over night.
